About 88cutouts

88cutouts is a small, hand-kept library of transparent PNG stickers, frames and letter cutouts made for one thing: decorating Instagram Stories. Every sticker is drawn or assembled for this site, then published as a clean alpha-transparent PNG so it drops onto your Story without a white box around it.

There is nothing to sign up for. Tap Copy on any sticker and it goes to your phone's clipboard as an image — then long-press inside the Instagram Story editor and paste. If your browser doesn't support copying images, Download always works as a fallback. One thing worth knowing: Instagram feed posts flatten transparency to grey. Stories, DMs and most messengers keep it.

The ransom note typewriter works the same way — type a message, get a cut-out letter collage back as a transparent PNG.

Everything here is free for personal use: decorate your Stories, your group chats, your notes app. Please don't resell the files or bundle them into a paid pack. If you want to use something commercially, or you spot an asset that shouldn't be here, email me and I'll sort it out.

Made by Sarath. Questions, requests, takedowns: hello@88cutouts.com.
